iconicAnchor.label: Route 66 roadside signs and novelty architecture
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: Road-facing businesses establish the style's giant signs, literal novelty shapes, neon, long-distance legibility, automobile scale, and improvised commercial personality.

sources.title: A Marketing Perspective on Route 66 Roadside Architecture
supports: Roadside businesses used architecture, oversized signs, novelty form, and rapid visual recognition to attract motorists traveling at speed.

sources.title: Route 66: How to Preserve Your Sign
supports: Historic sign materials, paint, neon, mounting, scale, and weathering are specific physical features rather than a generic retro filter.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches vernacular form, street signal, hand drawn, vivid chroma, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/roadside-americana/generated-lead.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
